WITH driver_year_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    d."XCL_038" AS first_name,
    d."XCL_039" AS last_name,
    r."XCL_066" AS year,
    AVG(lt."XCL_048" / 1000.0) AS avg_lap_time
  FROM lapTimes lt
  INNER JOIN drivers d ON lt."XCL_044" = d."XCL_034"
  INNER JOIN races r ON lt."XCL_043" = r."XCL_065"
  WHERE r."XCL_066" BETWEEN 2004 AND 2010
  GROUP BY d."XCL_038", d."XCL_039", r."XCL_066"
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    first_name,
    last_name,
    year,
    avg_lap_time,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY avg_lap_time ASC) AS rn
  FROM driver_year_avg
)
SELECT 
  first_name || ' ' || last_name AS full_name,
  year,
  avg_lap_time
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY year, rn

)

  year,
  avg_lap_time

WITH lap_seconds AS (
    SELECT
        r.XCL_066 AS year,
        lt.XCL_044 AS driver_id,
        (
            CAST(SUBSTR(lt.XCL_047, 1, INSTR(lt.XCL_047, '.') - 1) AS REAL) +
            CAST(SUBSTR(lt.XCL_047, INSTR(lt.XCL_047, '.') + 1) AS REAL)
        ) AS lap_time_sec
    FROM lapTimes lt
    JOIN races r ON lt.XCL_043 = r.XCL_065
    WHERE r.XCL_066 BETWEEN 2004 AND 2010
      AND lt.XCL_047 IS NOT NULL
      AND lt.XCL_047 != ''
),
driver_year_avg AS (
    SELECT
        year,
        driver_id,
        AVG(lap_time_sec) AS avg_lap_time
    FROM lap_seconds
    GROUP BY year, driver_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        dya.year,
        dya.driver_id,
        dya.avg_lap_time,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dya.year ORDER BY dya.avg_lap_time ASC) AS rn
    FROM driver_year_avg dya
)
SELECT
    d.XCL_037 || ' ' || d.XCL_038 AS full_name,
    rk.year,
    rk.avg_lap_time
FROM ranked rk
JOIN drivers d ON rk.driver_id = d.XCL_034
WHERE rk.rn <= 3
ORDER BY rk.year, rk.rn
